system_user.description: User account under which amavisd-new runs

milter_port.description: TCP port for inet socket (used when MILTERSOCKET is set to inet:port@host)

milter_host.description: Host/IP for inet socket (used when MILTERSOCKET is set to inet:port@host)

chroot_milter_socket.description: Unix socket path inside chroot (e.g. for postfix)

working_dir.description: Working directory for mail queuing (must match amavisd-new TEMPBASE)

extra_params.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to amavisd-milter

milter_socket_owner.description: Owner and group for milter socket (used with MILTERSOCKETOWNER)

milter_socket_mode.description: Permissions mode for milter socket (used with MILTERSOCKETMODE)
